title: Sthaneeka Bhattars make contradictory statements on the lighting of deepam
description: On November 24, the Executive Officer of the Subramaniya Swamy Temple at Thirupparankundram had said the reasoning for lighting the lamp at the Deepa Mandapam was backed by the Bhattars. But a letter purportedly written by the Bhattars, stating that they had not given any letter of consent, went viral on social media the next day
